plugin_description: Drop-in Tizen widget for Samsung Smart TV. Put the JAR in plugins/ — no server changes required.
settings.title: Samsung TV Widget
settings.description: Standalone plugin: it publishes a Tizen widget into the web static root. Leave the server URL empty to use the address you opened Avalon from, or set a LAN URL the TV can reach. Install /widgets/samsung.wgt, add the Widget URL in URL Launcher, or point Media Station X at /widgets/msx/start.json.
settings.public_url: Public server URL for the TV (optional)
settings.install_steps: 1) Enable Developer Mode on the TV (Apps → 1-2-3-4-5). 2) Install /widgets/samsung.wgt via Tizen Studio / sdb, or add the Widget URL in URL Launcher. 3) Optional: point Media Station X to /widgets/msx/start.json.
